limitations: Records are selected disclosure contexts, not unique deals, new announcements, completed transactions or trading signals. Multiple concepts and dimensions can describe the same activity.
A disclosure may contain prior-period activity, denial, planned transactions, accounting updates or no activity. No event, target, amount, materiality or novelty is extracted from taxonomy alone.
Accession, filing date, reporting period and source context dates are not announcement or effective dates. Retrospective collection is not historical decision-time availability.
Exact standard concepts and two taxonomy versions only; custom concepts, other versions and untagged disclosures are outside scope. Absence is not evidence of no acquisition or divestiture.
Raw prepared TXT including escaping, language, footnotes, duration, context and dimensions stays private and uninterpreted. It is not original filing byte evidence.
Full TXT canonical row hash excludes SQLite rowid; value hash covers UTF-8 of retained text exactly, without HTML unescape, normalization or inference.

Database and archive pins identify retained inputs. Prior full-field ingestion audit establishes derivation; this utility does not authenticate source clocks or independently prove database-to-archive derivation.
Queue fields remain unknown until source interpretation and independent temporal/security qualification. No paper-engine activation or price/outcome/model admission.
